description: Search open listings (offers) on OLTechX, the Bulgarian tech marketplace. Free-text query in Bulgarian or English (e.g. 'RTX 3060', 'iPhone 13 128GB', 'PS5'), with optional category, condition, city and EUR price range. Returns up to 24 results per page with price, condition, city and URL. When nothing matches it returns similar models that have listings, and always an alert link so the user can be notified about new matches.

city.description: Bulgarian city name in Cyrillic, e.g. 'София', 'Пловдив', 'Варна'

sort.description: 'deal' = best price compared to the usual price for the model

name: search_listings
title: Search listings
